title: The ZCC API from a client's side: hosts, sign-in, limits, conventions and wire notes
aliases: how to call the zcc api

prose.text: Endpoint lists, HTTP methods, query parameters and request and response fields are generated from the captured contract and the SDKs: run `node scripts/kb.mjs surface zcc` and read `vendor/zscaler-api-specs/automate-zscaler/openapi/zcc.openapi.json`. This subject family holds only the behavior around them.

prose.label: Calling the API.
prose.text: Hosts and signing in, on the OneAPI gateway or the legacy login, are in [[zcc.api.authentication]]. Limits and how the clients back off are in [[zcc.api.rate-limits]]. Casing, query parameters, caching and status codes are in [[zcc.api.conventions]]. The RESTful v2 families and their paging are in [[zcc.api.v2-wire]].

prose.label: Wire notes by area.
prose.text: Web policies (app profiles): [[zcc.api.web-policy-wire]]. Trusted networks, v1 and v2: [[zcc.api.trusted-networks-wire]]. Forwarding profiles and the fail-open policy: [[zcc.api.forwarding-profile-wire]]. Devices, downloads and device secrets: [[zcc.api.devices-wire]]. Admin users and admin sync: [[zcc.api.admin-users-wire]]. Company info and password management: [[zcc.api.company-wire]]. Web privacy (User Privacy) settings: [[zcc.api.web-privacy-wire]]. Entitlements: [[zcc.api.entitlements-wire]].

prose.label: Clients.
prose.text: The Go SDK's legacy-mode routing defect is in [[zcc.sdk-go.legacy-routing]], and the Terraform provider's handling of forwarding-profile and other fields is in [[zcc.terraform.field-fidelity]].
